rules.title: Out of Memory (Java Heap Space Exhausted)
patterns: There is insufficient memory for the Java Runtime Environment to continue
rules.cause_explanation: Minecraft ran out of allocated RAM (-Xmx) while loading textures, chunks, or mods.

rules.title: Incompatible Java Version (UnsupportedClassVersionError)
patterns: java\.lang\.UnsupportedClassVersionError: .* has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime \(class file version (?P<class_ver>\d+)\.\d+\)
rules.cause_explanation: A mod or the game itself requires a newer Java version than the one currently selected for this instance.

fix.label: Switch to Required Java Runtime Automatically

rules.title: Legacy Forge Requires Java 8
patterns: java\.lang\.ClassCastException: class jdk\.internal\.loader\.ClassLoaders\$AppClassLoader cannot be cast to class java\.net\.URLClassLoader
rules.cause_explanation: Minecraft 1.12.2 and older Forge/LaunchWrapper versions rely on Java 8 internals removed in Java 9+.

rules.title: Missing Required Mod Dependency
patterns: Missing or unsupported mandatory dependencies:\s*Mod ID: '(?P<dep_id>[a-z0-9_\-]+)', Requested by: '(?P<mod_id>[a-z0-9_\-]+)'
rules.cause_explanation: An installed mod requires another library or API mod (such as Fabric API or Cloth Config) that is not installed.

rules.title: Duplicate Mod Jars Detected
rules.cause_explanation: Two different jar files in your mods/ folder provide the same mod ID.

rules.title: Mod Mixin Conflict or Bytecode Injection Error
rules.cause_explanation: A mod failed to patch the game's code, usually because it was built for a different Minecraft version or conflicts with another optimization mod.

rules.title: Graphics Driver Crash (Native OpenGL/Vulkan Error)
patterns: GLFW error 65542: WGL: The driver does not appear to support OpenGL
GLFW error 65543: GLX: Failed to create context
rules.cause_explanation: Your GPU graphics driver crashed or failed to initialize an OpenGL context.

fix.label: Force Discrete GPU & Safe OpenGL Flags
